_about: DRAFT toll tariffs, vehicle category 1 (passenger car / motorcycle, height up to 2 m), researched 2026-10-27 for the Verst trip planner.

METHOD CAVEAT: from this sandbox every Russian site (avtodor-tr.ru, russianhighways.ru, m11-neva.ru, mos-spb.ru, ckad operator, news sites) and also web.archive.org / wikipedia were UNREACHABLE (DNS failure / proxy 403). No page was fetched. All numbers come from web-search result snippets/summaries; the source URL given is the page the snippet came from. Nothing has been checked against the official tariff PDF. Re-verify on avtodor-tr.ru/road/tariffs/ (Avtodor), m11-neva.ru (M-11 km 15-58), mos-spb.ru/tariffs (M-11 km 543-684), m-road.ru (Northern Odintsovo bypass) before shipping.

Main 2026 tariff event: Avtodor (Автодор - Платные дороги) annual indexation effective 2026-03-02 00:00 (order No. 56 of 2026-02-27 per RIA for CKAD). Increase 3.5-15% depending on section, average ~12.7% for cars per Kommersant (https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8478445); some socially significant sections unchanged. In January 2026 Avtodor had denied an indexation (https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8378259), so pages from Jan-Feb 2026 quote PRE-indexation prices.

M-11 km 15-58 is a separate concession (ООО «Северо-Западная концессионная компания», brand «М11 Подмосковье», m11-neva.ru): own indexation from 2026-01-12 (+3-9 %, +10..100 RUB/trip for cars) and a seasonal peak (Fri-Sun) surcharge valid 2026-04-24 .. 2026-11-01 (https://chehov-vid.ru/news/society/46872/sezonnoe-povyshenie-tsen-na-m-11/). After 2026-11-01 weekend prices on km 15-58 are expected to fall back; new values not found.
Seasonal 'winter tariffs from 1 November' existed on the Avtodor network in 2020 (https://www.interfax.ru/russia/734965); no evidence found that a 2026 winter tariff switch is planned.

Day-of-week rule (Avtodor, cat. 1): weekday tariff = Monday-Thursday; weekend tariff = Friday, Saturday, Sunday, public non-working holidays and pre-holiday days (https://avtodor-tr.ru/road/tariffs/ snippet + older Avtodor press release).

Transponder (T-Pass, Автодор-Платные дороги): on Avtodor closed/open systems the transponder price is often equal to cash for cat. 1 and the saving comes from the loyalty programme (up to ~15 %) and subscriptions (абонементы, up to 45 %). Where only a 'transponder discount' percentage is known, transponderRub is null. Snippets claiming flat 10-50 % transponder discounts are from unofficial calculators and were not used.

Free-flow (M-12, CKAD, also A-289): no barriers; plate recognised by cameras; pay by transponder or by plate (Avtodor app/site) within 5 calendar days after the trip. Non-payment -> Rostransnadzor ruling under КоАП 12.21.4 part 1: 1 500 RUB for a car (5 000 RUB truck/bus); fine is cancelled if the trip is paid within 20 days of the ruling (sources: https://bip.ru/info/shtraf-za-ezdu-po-platnym-dorogam-bez-oplaty , https://rostransnadzor.gov.ru/rostransnadzor/podrazdeleniya/mtucfo/deyatelnost-podrazdeleniya/2706 , https://parkomatica.ru/blog/tpost/oplata-m12).

km values are the published section boundaries; lengthKm = kmTo - kmFrom unless stated. Sections with derived values say so in 'note'. null = unknown; never fill nulls with invented numbers in the engine - use perKmApproxRub fallback instead.

Confidence: high = official operator page or >=2 independent consistent 2026 sources incl. operator; medium = 2026 post-indexation figure from >=2 media sources or one media source that cites Avtodor; low = single unofficial snippet, undated, or possibly pre-indexation.
weekdayRule: weekday = Mon-Thu; weekend = Fri-Sun + public holidays + pre-holiday days (Avtodor cat. 1)
